Commits page: GitHub's grouped 'Commits on Jan 1, 2025' timeline headers with the commit Box rows (title semibold 14px, avatar 16px + author + 'committed 3 days ago' 12px muted, right: verified badge, short SHA monospace button group with copy + browse icon buttons). Branches page (GitHub: tabs Overview/Yours/Active/Stale/All, Box tables), Tags & Releases (GitHub release page: left date column, release card Box with title 32px? (h2 24px semibold per current github), 'Latest' green Label, markdown body, Assets collapsible list with file sizes, reactions), wiki (GitHub wiki: page title 32px with 'Edit'/'New page' buttons right, last edited meta, right sidebar 'Pages N' Box with filter and page list, clone wiki box). Run view (Vue RepoActionView, unlayered? check): summary header with status and triggered-by, left job list NavList with status icons, main job log panel — GitHub's log view is dark-ish? (verify on github.com action run reference docs/reference/action-run: check.bg and log text colors; steps as collapsible rows with chevron + status icon + name + duration, log lines monospace 12px with line numbers muted). Fix the layout-shift regression A-1 (action-run CLS 0.60 vs built-in 0.49 at 390; 0.42 vs 0.34 at 1440): reserve space / avoid taller header during mount; must be ≤ built-in. Packages: GitHub packages list (Box rows with package type icon, name semibold, version, published by, downloads) and package page (install command box with copy, readme, right sidebar details). Projects: GitHub Projects (classic boards feel): columns as Box with header (title semibold + counter + '...' menu), cards as Box with 8px padding, issue icon + title + labels, drag handle; column colors from Gitea's project column color (inline, exempt). Read docs/requests/pages-actions-packages-projects.md first.
